provider_info.prompt:
Reference image: use the supplied Ava seed as the exact identity, face, hair, wardrobe, product, and opening-frame lock.

Create one vertical 9:16 still in a 1986–1992 local-TV sponsor-bumper register. Ava remains centered from head to waist on the beach towel, facing the camera. Her right earbud stays worn; her hand holds the inline microphone module near her mouth without covering her face. The white wired earbud cable remains the second-sharpest element after her face.

Use flat broadcast-video contrast, warm analog chroma, slightly blown sunlight, soft scanlines, chroma bleed on the cable, and mild tape-generation texture. Preserve natural skin texture. Keep the ocean horizon and towel symmetric.
